pages.scan: I opened works/auto-6294ee8a2094/workflow/storyboards-unnumbered/page-07.png with Read and looked at it. It is a grey-box storyboard with no numbers. There are four panels: a wide tier at the top, two panels side by side in the middle tier, and a wide tier at the bottom. Reading order, left to right and top to bottom: (1) Top panel. The balloon at upper left, with its tail pointing right to the 'meera' box, reads: 'Welbuk Health is designed to help patients stay connected with their care.' The 'ravi' box to the right has no text, so it is a silent listener. (2) Middle-left panel. The balloon at upper left, with its tail pointing right to the 'ravi' box, reads: 'So I can keep useful information in one place?' Below it, a teal label box at the left edge reads 'WELBUK HEALTH / for patients'. I read it after the balloon. (3) Middle-right panel. The balloon at the top, with its tail pointing down to the 'meera' box, reads: 'That's the idea. Let's walk through what is available to you.' There is a 'ravi' marker dot at the far right edge, outside any face box. (4) Bottom panel. The rectangular caption across the top reads: 'A smoother visit. A more connected experience.' There are small 'anany' and 'meera' boxes at centre-left and a 'ravi' box at right. None of them has dialogue, so this is a silent closing beat.
pages.observation: The order is clear. There is only one text element per tier, apart from the teal label, so a reader cannot skip a reply. The statement, question and answer chain from panel 1 to panel 3 holds up: Meera's 'That's the idea.' directly answers Ravi's question. Tails go to the boxes I would expect: panel 1 to meera, panel 2 to ravi, panel 3 to meera. Ambiguities: (a) The teal 'WELBUK HEALTH / for patients' box in panel 2 sits flush against the panel's left border. It is unclear whether it is a sign in the scene, an app screen or a caption, and from the storyboard alone it could be read before the balloon. (b) In panel 3 the 'ravi' marker sits at x~970 with no face box, and its label runs past the panel and page edge ('ravi' is cut off). Whether Ravi is visible there is unclear. (c) In panel 4 there is no text tying the three small figures to the caption, so the meaning depends on the art. (d) The panel 1 tail tip reaches into the meera box area, and the panel 2 tail tip touches the ravi box edge. That is fine in a storyboard, but the final art should be checked for the tails touching faces. All text was legible.
